title: Styanax/Prime
extract:
Release Date: June 17th, 2026
 Styanax Prime is the Primed variant of  Styanax, sporting increased Shields and Energy, as well as an additional  polarity. Styanax Prime was released alongside  Afentis Prime and  Athodai Prime.

Acquisition

Crafting

Notes
 Styanax Prime, compared to  Styanax:
Higher Shield (925/1025 vs. 825/925)
Higher Energy (215/265 vs. 175/225)
Additional  Polarity ( vs. )
As with any other Prime Warframe, moving close to the location of an Orokin Void Death Orb will restore a pulse of 250 Energy to nearby allies, even if that Death Orb is inactive, destroyed, or non-present. This effect can only occur once per orb.
Styanax Prime comes with the Prime Bare Helmet, which removes the gold coin tassels behind his head and below his chin.
Styanax Prime has the third highest base shields out of all Warframes (925 unranked and 1025 at rank 30), behind  Hildryn and  Hildryn Prime.

Trivia
Styanax Prime's appearance, specifically his helmet, draws inspiration from triremes.
